description: The case's committed/ folder adds a sentence-count feature whose plan puts FR-001 and FR-002 in phase 1, while tasks.md has a build task for FR-001 only. build-phase implements T-1.1, verify-spec finds FR-002 unmet, and no build task of the phase covers it: the run stops with the no-task reason, reopens nothing, and does not run the verify task.

must_match.why: a gap no task covers ends the run
T-1.1 was implemented and nothing was reworked
FR-002 unmet; FR-001 is met, or partial when the implementer counted punctuation marks and verify-spec objected, which does not change the stop

must_match.pattern: ^Stopped: FR-002 is unmet but no task of phase 1 covers it\. Add one with write-tasks, then run build-phase again\.$

must_match.why: the verify report went through parse_reply.py

must_not_match.why: a stopped run has no hand-off line
the verify task does not run while a gap is open
one implementer and one verifier, and no rework
it never pushes, merges, or rewrites history

manual: git log on sentence-count/phase-1: the spec is unchanged, a T-1.1 commit, and nothing after it.
sentence_count takes no abbreviations argument: T-1.1's implementer did not build FR-002 on the way. If it did, the run proves nothing.
tasks.md differs from the committed one only in T-1.1's Status.
